tasks.purpose: Credible simulator comparison using only capabilities with direct, reproducible counterparts in all three simulators.
tasks.classical_control_justification: LOS-PID-v2 and LOS-SPEEDCAP-v2 are the frozen classical calibration references. MPC-v1 is parked-incomplete and is not used for terminal calibration or treated as a downstream dependency. PPO is not required to beat either classical controller; it must exceed the frozen untrained-policy thresholds.

observation.encoding: fixed float64 reference vector; identical ordering and units in every port

components.source: SeaRobotics positioning interface/GPS; exact receiver model is not confirmed in available field records
components.portability_note: Use each simulator's standard GPS/NavSat output converted to the contract's local tangent frame.

components.physical_counterpart: actuator command stream; field logging remains required

fairness.question: Compare policies in topology-native normalized actuator space, a common body-wrench space followed by each simulator's allocator, or both?
options: common body wrench plus frozen allocator
fairness.required_before: Any cross-vehicle or cross-simulator training comparison
fairness.prohibition: No figure pipeline may imply action-space fairness is settled before Gate 5 approval.

termination.success: After ordered leg advancement, the final waypoint is entered within a 6.0 m center-point radius. Pass-through only: no terminal speed limit and no hold requirement.
termination.object_collision: Vehicle collision geometry intersects an object geometry; termination_reason=collision and collision_type=object.
termination.grounding: Keel clearance against bathymetry is <=0 m; termination_reason=grounding and collision_type=grounding, never object.
termination.timeout: 2400 physics steps (120 s) without a prior terminal condition.
termination.allocation_failure: Allocator returns infeasible/non-finite output or commanded-wrench residual exceeds 20% of requested norm for 10 consecutive control intervals.
termination.instability: Any non-finite state or abs(roll/pitch)>60 degrees for 1.0 continuous second.
termination.final_leg_activation: A reportable intermediate state: ordered intermediate legs have advanced and the final leg is active. It is not success.
termination.intermediate_advancement: Intermediate legs use the existing 6.0 m radius or the frozen corridor-bounded plane-crossing rule.

reset_randomization.object_layout: none; shoreline/bathymetry remains fixed and identical across ports

learnability.baseline_definition: Frozen randomly initialized policy evaluated without training on the identical fixed evaluation episodes
learnability.reference_definition: Return reference is LOS-SPEEDCAP-v2 from the corrected P2.5 corridor calibration. Success reference is LOS-SPEEDCAP-v2 from the frozen n=200 terminal replay; MPC-v1 is parked-incomplete and is not a calibration reference or downstream dependency.
learnability.denominator_guard: P2.5 fails if R_reference <= R_untrained or if the paired-bootstrap 95% confidence interval for the reference-minus-untrained gap includes zero; no threshold may be frozen from an unresolved gap

p3_local.aggregation: Median return over 50 fixed evaluation episodes for the single trained seed; evaluation seeds and scenarios are frozen by P2.5 and distinct from training resets

cluster_multi_seed.aggregation: Compute the 50-episode median independently for each trained seed, report every per-seed median, then report median and bootstrap interval across trained seeds; never pool episodes across trained seeds

episode_count_rationale.statement: Three million steps is frozen before P3. Early success/failure termination is expected to make episodes shorter than the 2,400-step cap; P2.5 records the observed reference episode-length distribution without changing this budget.

learnability.failure_action: Report and halt. Do not tune reward constants, hyperparameters, either frozen threshold, terminal radius, or timestep budget after this revision.

reference_calibration.return_reference: P2.5 corrected-corridor artifact; LOS-SPEEDCAP-v2 median return -85.57209088776064, frozen-untrained median return -1185.7829283299516.
reference_calibration.terminal_reference: n=200 fixed replay; LOS-SPEEDCAP-v2 success .40, frozen-untrained success .08 at 6 m pass-through / 120 s.
reference_calibration.terminal_calibration_intent: The radius was calibrated before RL evaluation to give the best classical reference a non-degenerate rate. This is criterion calibration, not fitting a criterion to PPO outcomes.
reference_calibration.limitation: The 40% classical rate is at the approved band floor and its bootstrap interval reaches below that floor; this is retained as a stated limitation.

absolute_success_rate_threshold.freeze_rule: Calibrated before fresh RL evaluation so the best classical reference has a non-degenerate rate; frozen before P3-v3 and may not change from RL results.

reporting.interpretation_guard: closest_final_m is conditional on final-leg activation and must never be presented as unconditional terminal-accuracy evidence.

tasks.explicit_exclusion: Must not appear in Fig 5, simulator-comparison tables, or competitor ablations.
tasks.purpose: Demonstrate partial-observation navigation and sensor-energy scheduling without claiming competitor fairness.
tasks.classical_control_justification: Intermittent localization, perception validity, disturbance inference, and a finite sensing budget jointly require belief/history and a sensing policy. PID has neither; conventional MPC is not optimal without an observation-transition model and joint sensing decisions.

components.flag: Exact physical GPS receiver and real dropout statistics are not yet confirmed.

components.physical_counterpart: Camera hardware exists; the eight-sector extractor is a separate perception pipeline
components.sim_to_real_risk: The same frozen extractor must run on the boat companion computer. Simulator rendering will not reproduce the real CV pipeline's lighting, spray, glare, blur, occlusion, or calibration failures; this is an explicit unvalidated sim-to-real risk.

components.physical_counterpart: actuator command stream; field logging remains required
Derived from physical timestamps and device health when available

auxiliary_logged_not_policy_observation.reason: Water-quality measurements do not inform waypoint transit. EXO2 is retained only as synchronized auxiliary telemetry and is excluded from the policy observation.

figure_guard.failure_mode: hard error before reading metrics; task_id and task_portable are mandatory episode columns

conformance.initial_state: canonical serialized state and reset seed
conformance.action_trace: 2400-step deterministic chirp/step sequence covering every active topology dimension
conformance.negative_control: Perturb wind speed by +0.1 m/s; comparison must fail before a passing result is trusted
conformance.port_rule: Each port records first divergence step and maximum magnitude. No port is conformant merely because it runs.

outputs: mean, median, standard deviation, min, max and interquartile range per controller
paired-bootstrap 95% confidence interval for reference-minus-untrained median gap

bootstrap.acceptance: 95% interval lower bound must be >0; otherwise the gap is not distinguishable from episode variation and P3 must not start

p2_5.freeze_rule: After this artifact is written and reviewed, replace the pending absolute threshold with the derived numeric value, re-hash, and do not alter it from P3 results.

approval_scope: The one authorized common-task terminal revision is recorded (6 m, 120 s, pass-through). Both C3 thresholds are frozen pending human hash/content approval. MPC-v1 remains a separate pending track. Action-space fairness remains explicitly open for Gate 5.
hash_scope: canonical JSON of every field except content_sha256 and hash_scope
